pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā cetiyesu cārikaṃ caramāno yena bhaddavatikā tena pāyāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.2: addasaṃsu kho gopālakā pasupālakā kasakā pathāvino bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.3: disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ mā kho bhante bhagavā ambatitthaṃ agamāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.4: ambatitthe bhante jaṭilassa assame nāgo paṭivasati iddhimā āsīviso ghoraviso
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.8: tatiyampi kho gopālakā pasupālakā kasakā pathāvino bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.9: mā kho bhante bhagavā ambatitthaṃ agamāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.10: ambatitthe bhante jaṭilassa assame nāgo paṭivasati iddhimā āsīviso ghoraviso
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.13: athakho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bhaddavatikā tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā bhaddavatikāyaṃ viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.14: athakho āyasmā sāgato yena ambatitthaṃ jaṭilassa assamo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvānisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.15: addasā kho so nāgo āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ paviṭṭhaṃ disvāna dukkhī dummano padhūpāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.17: athakho so nāgo makkhaṃ asahamāno pajjali.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.19: athakho āyasmā sāgato tassa nāgassa tejasā tejaṃ pariyādayitvā yena bhaddavatikā tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.20: athakho bhagavā bhaddavatikāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.21: assosuṃ kho kosambikā upāsakā ayyo kira sāgato ambatitthakena nāgena saddhiṃ saṅgāmesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.22: athakho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kosambī tadavasari. athakho kosambikā upāsakā bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ karitvā yenāyasmā sāgato tenupasaṅkamiṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.23: upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho kosambikā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.24: kiṃ bhante ayyānaṃ dullabhañca manāpañca kiṃ paṭiyādemāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.25: evaṃ vutte chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kosambike upāsake etadavocuṃ atthāvuso kāpotikā nāma pasannā bhikkhūnaṃ dullabhā ca manāpā ca taṃ paṭiyādethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.26: athakho kosambikā upāsakā ghare ghare kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ paṭiyādetvā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ disvāna āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ etadavocuṃ pivatu bhante ayyo sāgato kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ pivatu bhante ayyo sāgato kāpotikaṃ pasannanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.27: athakho āyasmā sāgato ghare ghare kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ pivitvā nagaramhā nikkhamanto nagaradvāre paripati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.28: athakho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ nagaramhā nikkhamanto addasa āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ nagaradvāre paripatitaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.29: disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi gaṇhatha bhikkhave sāgatanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.30: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ ārāmaṃ netvā yena bhagavā tena sīsaṃ katvā nipātesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.31: athakho āyasmā sāgato parivattitvā yena bhagavā tena pāde katvā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.32: athakho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi nanu bhikkhave sāgato tathāgate sagāravo ahosi sappatissoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.34: api nu kho bhikkhave sāgato etarahi tathāgate sagāravo sappatissoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.36: nanu bhikkhave sāgato ambatitthakena nāgena saṅgāmesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.38: api nu kho bhikkhave sāgato etarahi pahoti deḍḍubhenapi saddhiṃ saṅgāmetunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.40: api nu kho bhikkhave taṃ pātabbaṃ yaṃ pivitvā visaññī assāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.42: ananucchavikaṃ bhikkhave sāgatassa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.43: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave sāgato majjaṃ pivissati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.44: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe… …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.45: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:2.3.2: amajjañca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasaṃ taṃ pivati
